hero.lead: Scholarships, internships, hackathons and camps — scanned daily, ranked by your profile, checked for eligibility before you ever open the page.

how.title: How it works
how.s1: Field, year, skills, wilaya. Stored privately — used only to rank matches. Only you can see this.
how.s2: The agent reads more than 47 official sources, scores every opportunity against your profile and checks eligibility — reasons included.
how.s3: We open the official page so you can verify every detail yourself. Nothing is sent until you press Submit.

privacy.title: Your search stays yours.
privacy.body: We never sell your data, never email you without consent, and never submit anything on your behalf.
privacy.p2: Nothing is sent until you press Submit
privacy.p3: Always verify on the official page
